title: Brazil's high-stakes presidential runoff could reshape country's future
summary: Brazil's presidential runoff pits President Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro in a near-tied race that could decide whether the country joins a rightward shift across the Americas. Stephanie Sy reports from a Rio favela and São Paulo, where voters are split over social programmes, corruption, crime and the cost of living. Journalist Patrícia Campos Mello expects the race to be even more contentious than in 2022.
